column1: # partitions.csv — flash partition map for gate-firmware (4 MB target).
# Two-OTA layout: each app slot is 1.5 MB which leaves comfortable room for
# our binaries (LWIP + W5500 + esp-tls + grpc-c brings the application close
# to 1 MB) plus headroom for compression overhead. NVS holds runtime
# configuration; otadata records which OTA slot the bootloader booted last;
# storage is a small SPIFFS for offline-mode allowlist cache.
